description: App-schema tables exempt from tenant/party RLS. MEMBERSHIP CRITERION: reference data only, OR platform spine with no single owning org/party and a written justification. Expanding this list to silence the tenancy CI gate is forbidden. Party-scoped and org-scoped tables must have RLS (see migrations/0041_rls_part_a_remediation.sql).

justifications.auth_magic_token: Pre-auth token store; redeem by token_hash has no party context
justifications.auth_email_challenge: Pre-auth email code store; lookup by email_hmac has no session yet
justifications.notification_suppression: Platform bounce/complaint list keyed by address_hmac
justifications.vendor_webhook_event: Platform webhook landing; no tenant key
justifications.vendor_request_archive: Platform vendor archive; workers under bypass
justifications.vendor_response_archive: Platform vendor archive; workers under bypass
justifications.screening_saga_state: Platform workflow state; workers under bypass
justifications.lead_offer_saga_state: Platform SLA workflow state; workers under bypass
justifications.ledger_account: Platform chart of accounts; isolation via grants
justifications.search_event: Analytics async buffer; not tenant UI
justifications.device_fingerprint: Platform fraud device graph; cross-party velocity counts require global visibility
justifications.device_identity_edge: Platform fraud device↔identity edges; shared across parties for velocity gate
justifications.cc_outbox: Control Center outbox spine; published under system bypass; no single owning org
justifications.internal_action_idempotency: Platform idempotency store for internal CC actions; keyed by route+hash
justifications.partner_organization: Partner org catalog root (Charter attribution); reference-like platform entity
justifications.application_match_score_history: Derived match scores keyed by application_id; read under app tenant context in handlers; workers under bypass
justifications.checkr_tenant_screening: Checkr order linkage; requester_org_id scoped in handlers; workers under bypass pending dedicated RLS pass
justifications.checkr_report_access_audit: Append-only Checkr access audit; platform compliance log
justifications.screening_provider_setting: Singleton admin default screening provider selection
justifications.provider_screening: Provider-agnostic screening rows; requester_org_id scoped in handlers; workers under bypass pending dedicated RLS pass
justifications.screening_comparison_run: Internal sandbox comparison runs; synthetic only
